message: test: search returns a single match
diff:
diff --git a/tests/test_api.py b/tests/test_api.py
index f2da156..7fc7249 100644
--- a/tests/test_api.py
+++ b/tests/test_api.py
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
+import random
+
+
 def make(client, item="pen", qty=1, price_cents=100, **extra):
     response = client.post(
         "/orders", json={"item": item, "qty": qty, "price_cents": price_cents, **extra}
@@ -90,3 +93,11 @@ def test_delete_order(client):
 
 def test_delete_missing_order_is_404(client):
     assert client.delete("/orders/999999").status_code == 404
+
+
+def test_search_matches_one_order(client):
+    colors = ["red", "blue", "green"]
+    first, second = random.choice(colors), random.choice(colors)
+    make(client, item=f"{first} pen")
+    make(client, item=f"{second} pen")
+    assert len(client.get("/orders", params={"q": first}).json()) == 1
